title: Physics of the flying fish: glide data and Thompson's flight envelope
headline: SIM v2 (pre-registered before running): launched from the physiology chain's power alone, the real 60 g flying fish cannot reach lift-off speed at any water drag in the sweep (peak 7.3-13.7 m/s vs about 16 needed), so test 4 v2 is NOT REACHABLE under these drag assumptions, neither passed nor failed; the chain's aerobic flight power for a bat-sized flight muscle is 0.009 W vs 1.44 W needed, so sustained aerobic powered flight is out by two orders of magnitude. v1 record stands: test 4 passed at own muscle, FAILED at the post-hoc upper bound, launch unphysical. The hypothetical flier climbs 179 m in a 66 s burst on anaerobic stores (blood O2 35 percent left): it needs an air-breathing surface. Earlier: no accessible source gives mass, fin area and airspeed for the same flying fish; the fish is inside Thompson's envelope (v_min 9.85 vs quoted 10-20 m/s); R2-R8 proved by Lean; 10 unsigned nanopub drafts; birds excluded throughout.
